# Welcome {.unnumbered}

Welcome to AI for Clinical Study Workflows.

The goal of this book is to demonstrate the SDLC of building and maintain AI-first workflow 
for clinical trial development.

The book focus on showing general principals instead of detail implementations as that highly depends on 
the organization's AI strategy. 

Whether you are new to AI-native workflows or already working in clinical reporting,
you will find small, reusable examples you can adopt right away,
along with patterns and checklists for organizing work for
regulatory submission and effective team collaboration.

**This is a work-in-progress draft.**
